text.en: Quantifying Memorization is row 80 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the Evaluation Analysis area.
text.zh: Quantifying Memorization 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 80 行，所属领域为“评测与分析”。

text.en: The annual table associates Quantifying Memorization with “Quantifying Memorization Across Neural Language Models”.
text.zh: 年度表把 Quantifying Memorization 与论文《Quantifying Memorization Across Neural Language Models》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Nicholas Carlini, Daphne Ippolito, Matthew Jagielski, Katherine Lee, Florian Tramer, Chiyuan Zhang”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 Nicholas Carlini（官方页拼写）、Daphne Ippolito（官方页拼写）、Matthew Jagielski（官方页拼写）、Katherine Lee（官方页拼写）、Florian Tramer（官方页拼写）、Chiyuan Zhang（官方页拼写）；官方英文原文为“Nicholas Carlini, Daphne Ippolito, Matthew Jagielski, Katherine Lee, Florian Tramer, Chiyuan Zhang”。
